as_told.title: Experiment showing stones conduct electricity across a gap

plain: If you put voltage and electric current into one stone of the kind used in the pyramids, it arcs, like a spark, into the next stone. Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who argues the pyramids were built to make power and who says an alien told him their true purpose, says he and a collaborator named Ben showed this by experiment. He says it twice on the show, once naming Ben, as evidence that the stones could have carried electricity.
